source_kind: derived aggregate over retained CMS NPPES active organization practice-location evidence
ownership: CMS publishes the retained source fields; this publisher owns only the governed aggregate transformation.
allowed_use: separate primary and non-primary practice-location counts
prohibited_use: generic business total addition or double counting existing NPPES registry or pharmacy contributions
publishing organization names, NPIs, addresses, telephone numbers, taxonomies, source record identifiers, quarantine records, or raw records
claiming licensure, credentials, currently open premises, public access, unique businesses across sources, ownership, all healthcare organizations, or nationwide completeness
joining ZIP5 and ZIP4 or treating Census ZCTA membership as USPS validity
retention: Retain immutable aggregate releases with exact dependency pins.
redistribution: Governed aggregates only with CMS attribution, source-through date, provenance, and limitations.
personal_data_handling: Aggregate counts only; all record-level names, NPIs, addresses, telephone numbers, taxonomies, and source identifiers are prohibited.
privacy_warning: No names, NPIs, addresses, telephone numbers, taxonomies, source identifiers, quarantine records, or raw records may be exported.
attribution: Source: U.S. Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services National Plan and Provider Enumeration System.
